items.shared_referent: the caseworker's message that B's imprisoned father has been transferred to Northgate and can receive visitors Saturday
items.framing_a: B's relief is at the caseworker's message that B's father is now at Northgate, close enough to visit by bus.
items.framing_b: B's sadness is at the caseworker's message that B's father remains in prison at Northgate, even though visits are possible.
items.why: The same practical update can release the strain of an inaccessible parent or underscore the continuing separation; A only reports the message and the travel detail.
